en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a historic dining or meeting room. A long table with a white cloth and simple wooden chairs stands in the center. On the right, a large, ornate tiled ceramic stove with elaborate relief decoration dominates the room. The walls feature dark wooden paneling, heavy door frames, and a balcony or gallery with carved wooden railing on the upper right. Simple pendant lamps hang from the ceiling, and vases with flowers sit on the table and near the stove. Handwritten white numbers or notes appear at the top right edge of the image, as often seen on early photographic postcards.
